RYGBP is an effective tool for reducing the number of medications used to treat obesity related co-morbid conditions.
the mean number of prescription medications was decreased from 2.44 to 0.57 and the mean monthly cost of prescription medications was reduced from $187.24 to $42.53.

the impact of RYGBP on the reduction of the cost of pharmaceuticals in a managed care setting.
the cost-effectiveness of RYGBP in the treatment of co-morbid obesity.
the effect of RYGBP on prescription medication requirements and cost-savings in patients with morbid obesity.

RYGBP can reduce the number of prescriptions and the cost of prescriptions for patients with obesity related hypertension and diabetes.
